description: Look up a Brazilian company by CNPJ in the Receita Federal open register and return legal and trade name, registration status, opening date, legal nature, size, share capital, main CNAE activity and address. Check digits are validated first, including the alphanumeric CNPJ. Partners and contact data are not returned. Use validate_tax_id when you only need the check digits. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /br/cnpj via x402.

cnpj.description: CNPJ with or without dots, slash and dash, e.g. 19.131.243/0001-97.

name: br_cnpj
title: Brazilian company from a CNPJ
